steps.title: Create your profile
steps.description: Sign up and complete your academic and personal details along with your study preferences.

steps.title: AI recommendations
steps.description: Our AI matches your profile with thousands of scholarships and ranks them by compatibility.

steps.title: Explore and save
steps.description: Browse results, check eligibility requirements, and save the scholarships you want to apply for.

steps.title: Prepare and apply
steps.description: Track your deadlines and apply directly through the scholarships' official links.

matching.title: Smart scholarship matching
matching.description: Our AI analyzes your academic profile and matches you with scholarships based on eligibility, major, GPA, and preferences — ranked by compatibility.

documents.title: AI document enhancement
documents.description: Upload your CV or motivation letter. Our AI suggests improvements to grammar, structure, and scholarship fit.

reminders.title: Deadline reminders
reminders.description: Never miss a deadline. Get notified 7 days and 48 hours before your saved scholarships' deadlines.

items.quote: The profile completion system guided me step by step. Once I reached 70%, the AI started showing matching scholarships and I found a great one.
items.name: Omar Khalil
items.subtitle: Environmental Science, Nablus

items.quote: The document enhancement feature helped me rewrite my motivation letter. The suggestions were genuinely useful and I stayed in full control.
items.name: Sara Hamdan
items.subtitle: Public Health, Ramallah

items.quote: ScholarAI matched me with the Turkish government scholarship in minutes. I applied and got accepted! The AI matching saved me weeks of searching.
items.name: Ahmad Al-Najjar
